d: We are seeking a highly skilled and experienced Relationship Manager to join our team. The successful candidate will be responsible for building and nurturing strong relationships with large corporate clients. This position requires a proven track record in developing multi-million asset and liability books and cross selling a wide range of products.
q: Proven Track Record: Demonstrated success in building and managing strong relationships. A verifiable track record of developing multi-billion asset and liability books is essential.
Industry Experience: Extensive experience in corporate banking and good understanding of relevant products, services, fintech and market dynamics is preferred.

Financial Acumen: Strong financial analysis skills and the ability to assess creditworthiness, financial statements, and risk factors. Familiarity with digital assets and emerging technologies in the financial industry.

Business Development Skills: Proven ability to identify and convert business opportunities. Excellent networking and relationship-building skills with a demonstrated ability to cross-sell multiple products and drive revenue growth.
Communication and Presentation: Excellent communication and interpersonal skills. Ability to effectively present complex financial solutions to clients and stakeholders.
Team Player: Collaborative mindset with the ability to work effectively within a startup environment. Strong leadership qualities and the ability to mentor and guide junior team members.
Qualifications: Bachelor's degree in Finance, Economics, Business Administration, or a related field. Additional certifications such as CFA, ACCA, or similar would be advantageous.
Fluency in Arabic is a plus.
